item.title: Live: No reaction from double murderer Lamarre-Condon as guilty verdicts delivered
item.description: The former police officer had pleaded not guilty to murdering his former partner Jesse Baird and his new boyfriend Luke Davies in 2024, with his team arguing self-defence. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sydney fire ant infestation more serious than first thought
item.description: A nest detected in Auburn was successfully treated at the weekend, but further surveillance has revealed a more extensive presence of fire ants requiring intensive treatment and a broader biosecurity response. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Pensioners win private health insurance rebate carve out
item.description: The government has caved to demands to exempt part and full pensioners from plans to wind back private health insurance rebates for over 65s. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Inflation rises more than expected in 'RBA's worst nightmare'
item.description: The consumer price index has come in hotter than expected and underlying inflation has also risen, leaving Australia grappling with accelerating price rises and increasing unemployment. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Public hospital to fill IVF gap ahead of Catholic health takeover

item.title: Bogong moths can migrate using an internal geomagnetic compass
item.description: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03693-w Australian migratory moths navigate long distances, in part owing to a stellar ‘compass’. It transpires that they have another compass that detects the inclination, or angle, of Earth’s magnetic field lines and that probably relies on a light-dependent quantum-mechanical mechanism similar to the one found in night-migratory songbirds. Fuente: Nature.

item.title: Rudy Giuliani receives US's top honour, but press not invited to ceremony
item.description: US President Donald Trump issued a federal pardon to Mr Giuliani last year and previously promised him the honour. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 10-hour stand-off ends in arrest after police allegedly threatened with gun
item.description: A 48-year-old man will face court today after a stand-off with police in a regional WA city, lasting just under 10 hours, during which he allegedly threatened officers with a handgun. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Breaking: Flinders Island bushfire prompts emergency warning for residents, tourists
item.description: Tasmania Fire Service issues a bushfire emergency warning for Killiecrankie, Leeka and Mount Tanner on Flinders Island, telling residents it is too late to leave. There is also an emergency warning for Mount Boyes, Carnacs Flat and Lughrata. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The major parties are ramping up their campaigns as election day approaches, with the Coalition promising $5 million to "clean up" Victoria if voted into government on Saturday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sydney medical student identifies 5 relatives in forgotten 1965 film after social media appeal
item.description: A 1965 film uncovered in Melbourne became a bridge connecting a Sydney medical student to previously unknown relatives. This discovery showcased three generations of his family outside their residence in Mitcham. After British director Karen Walsh endeavored to uncover the family's identity, the medical student recognized his great-grandmother among the footage shared online. With the help of ABC Melbourne, the quest for family links successfully culminated. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'I miss being on court' - Sinner has 'minor surgery' on knee
item.description: World number two Jannik Sinner says he has had "minor surgery" on his knee, just seven weeks before January's Australian Open begins. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Sheehan out of Wallabies Test after two-game ban
item.description: Ireland's stand-in captain Dan Sheehan will be banned for two games after a croc-roll tackle against South Africa and will play no part against Australia on Friday night. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Top Chinese official under investigation as Xi's anti-corruption probe widens
item.description: The probe against Chen Jining is a sign that President Xi Jinping's sweeping 14-year anti-corruption campaign is expanding ahead of the key party congress next year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Ukraine confirms hit on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland, as escalation fears grow
item.description: Saturday's strike on a Russian vessel, and several other incidents across Europe, are provoking fears of the Ukraine war spilling over into other parts of Europe. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Deep-sea clam discovered living inside the throat of a sea urchin
item.description: A new species of bivalve has been discovered living inside the esophagus of a deep-sea urchin in one of the most unusual partnerships known among clams. Named Vaticinaria gulicola, it was found on the abyssal seafloor of the Great Australian Bight, at depths of about 4,000 to 5,000 meters (13,100 to 16,400 feet). Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Diverse diets may reflect choice, not scarcity, among Australian hunters 45,000 years ago
item.description: A decade-long project in remote northwestern Australia suggests archaeologists should rethink a long-held assumption about the diets of humans almost 50,000 years ago. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Six ways teens can better protect themselves from online harms
item.description: It's been nearly a year since Australia's under-16 social media ban came into effect. The restrictions were touted as a measure to protect young people from harmful design features that keep them online longer, while shielding them from risks that come with using social media. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Warmer water reshapes venom chemistry in tiny jellyfish
item.description: The tiny Irukandji jellyfish Carukia barnesi lives in the waters of northern Australia, predominantly in Queensland, with similar species in Western Australia. Irukandji stings can be lethal. These stings can cause a range of symptoms—nausea, muscle pain, vomiting and traumatic psychological effects. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Bull shark records reveal links between warmer waters, rainfall and activity near Queensland beaches
item.description: One of Australia's largest and longest studies of bull shark habits has identified their preferred conditions for nearshore swimming—and warmer waters in summer and autumn are top of the list. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Indigenous land management practices can deliver improved conservation outcomes, study notes
item.description: Indigenous fire management in Australia provides one of the world's best examples of how traditional methods can protect fire-prone environments, and this inclusive approach should be prioritized in modern conservation, according to research led by Charles Darwin University (CDU). Fuente: Phys.org.
